svg.aria-label: Architecture: a SessionStart hook starts the installer when engines are missing, the installer writes ~/.rea-engines, the launcher reads it and spawns the unmodified REA MCP server, a UserPromptSubmit router adds context for reverse-engineering prompts, and make-report turns evidence JSON into reports

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three small Node scripts around the unmodified REA server. Nothing patches REA; the plugin talks to it like any MCP client.
